rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.

Spearman 
"I have been sent by Count Flamel Crowley, to announce that your presence in these territories is unacceptable. The power of his Empire cannot be overwhelmed!"

Advisor  
"Damn your impudence! How dare you speak to us in that tone, little human! We care not who you work for, you and your consorts will be crushed should our Lord desire it."

Baroness 
"Who is this Crowley? This one speaks as though possessed. We must meet this man."

Guard 
"Halt! What manner of creature approaches? Demons!? To your posts, men!"

Hierophant 
"The Highfather protects this city. You were warned!"

Advisor 
"Master, the texts within the vaults have much to say about the state of the Humans. This faction, the followers of Count Crowley, have begun a holy Inquisition. His targets are those who also seek the throne. Civil war within the Empire!"

Advisor 
"In any case, these Humans were well prepared - they were stockpiling for the war!"

Crowley's Assassins 
"While I despise everything you stand for, and I'm sure you feel the same, perhaps we can come to an...understanding? We seem to have a common enemy, as it turns out - the Elves. I'm sure you catch my meaning..."

Advisor 
"Why do you assume we hunt Elves? Are you attempting to spy on us? We should spill your entrails for even considering such a thing."

Dwarves 
"We weren't looking for a fight, beasts, but now you've got one. The Clans will not let this go unpunished!"

Advisor 
"There are official scrolls and writings here. It seems as if these humans have plans to overthrow the Empire. Their leaders are religious fanatics, inquisitors and the like. Who starts an Inquisition without inviting the demons? Hahaha!"

Advisor 
"This is typical of the foolish Humans, master! Leaving the castles empty! Ha! Although they may be planning to ambush us. Hmmm. We should be on our guard anyhow."

Advisor 
"We have also found texts in this town that detail how Count Crowley rose against the "heretic" humans willing to aid the Elves. What does this mean? The Elves now have allies? This could be a serious threat to our schemes."

Advisor 
 "Luckily for the Empire, this city was relatively close and easy to control. They did not succumb to Crowley's troops. All the better for us, tonight we dine on mortal flesh."

Advisor 
"This monastery tells of Elven lands east of here. These runes only have uninteresting records of their religious practices. Why would they attract the Clans?"

Orc 
"Elves make us fight corpse men. Elves hurt us if we don't. You are not corpse men, why do you hurt us too?  Now the Elves will be angry, we should not be here."

Advisor 
"How delightful. So the Elves are forcing the Greenskins to do their dirty work. What an unorthodox pairing. Perhaps with the Orcs fleeing, the 'corpse men' of Mortis will cause the Elves more grief."

Advisor 
"We've never seen the beasts so submissive. The Elven magic must be more powerful than we anticipated..."

Advisor 
"The bones of the dead litter the ground and signs of great battles are present. A war, no doubt, but why...and over what?"

Advisor 
"These monks were no doubt researching the Elven lore and Elven Gods. Why this sudden interest in them? It is very worrying. Who were these monks allied with: Crowley or the Empire?"

Advisor 
"The warriors here were well equipped! What a powerful blade we have recovered from the tower. It appears to have taken many heads in battle, and will certainly take many more still."

Advisor 
"Elven Boots!? Surely the Greenskins stole them from the forest dwellers, but why would Elves leave such an artifact unguarded? These Orcs hardly seem capable of raiding the Elven forces of these woods."

Advisor 
"We can learn no more from this area. It was simply another outpost for the Greenskins. We must move northwards to find the Elves."

Advisor 
"I do not think we'll learn anything from this ruin. It seems the Blacksmiths had little dealings with politics. It astounds me how much time these mortals squander on trivial tasks."

Advisor 
"This camp was used to train the Orc recruits - in their war against the Undead, no doubt."

Duke 
"Yes, we've cut off the flow of Greenskin reinforcements. They won't be interfering anymore."

Elf Lord 
"Demons?! Now you will face our alliance! You will regret meddling in the affairs of Gallean's warrior-born!"

Advisor 
 "Neither Elf nor Human will leave this battle unscarred. No...I have mispoken. Neither Elf nor Human will leave this battle."

Advisor 
"Bethrezen will be pleased! Behold the Elven riches we have retrieved from their Vaults! Wealth is wasted on such pathetic creatures!"

Advisor 
"We have defeated Jarous, Lord of Elves! Victory is ours, master!"

Baroness 
"Wait. See here, these scrolls tell us that the Elves had secured a negotiator to finalize their alliance!"
Advisor"What?!! Do you not see, Master, what this will lead to? If the Elves and the Empire unite, we will face a war on two fronts! We do not have the forces to..."

Baroness 
"We must put a stop to this!  Obviously we must intercept this "negotiator" and slay him."

Advisor 
"Master, Bethrezen demands that we spread his will across these lands. The Elves must surely be crippled after the war, yet they control far too much territory.  If we were to...cleanse...this area, our power might be doubled!"

Baroness 
"Let us not forget that these forest vermin often keep riches and powerful relics in their towns. Perhaps we can bend more mortals to our cause with Elven treasure."

Advisor 
"We must move quickly. The Elves are convinced that their mockery of a god has returned to them. If we allow their people to rally, it will take years to dispose of them."
A magical library based on ice and snow.
Come in, I will make worthy fighters out of your frail soldiers.

Advisor 
"Disgusting creatures. Now that the last stronghold of the Greenskins has fallen, I don't believe we should expect any more trouble from them."
